name: Retail
tagLine: Accurate workforce management and secure back-of-house access for retail operations.
body:
## The retail challenge

South African retail operations juggle high staff turnover, complex shift patterns, multi-site management and the ever-present threat of internal theft. Suprema's retail solutions tackle all three with biometric time and attendance that cannot be shared or forged, and access control that limits after-hours back-of-house entry to authorised personnel only.

## Workforce management for retail

- **Ghost employee prevention** — biometric clocking eliminates buddy-punching and time fraud, directly impacting payroll accuracy
- **Shift scheduling and overtime tracking** — BioStar 2's T&A module integrates with VIP Payroll, Sage 300 and PaySpace for automated payroll export
- **Multi-site centralisation** — manage time and attendance across all branches from head office, with site-by-site drill-down reporting
- **Public holiday and roster calendars** — South African public holiday calendars pre-loaded, with custom shift pattern support

## Back-of-house security

- **Stock room and cash office access** — restrict high-value areas to named individuals with time-limited credentials
- **Loading bay control** — BioEntry W3 weatherproof readers handle outdoor loading dock access in all weather conditions
- **Loss prevention integration** — access event data feeds into LP dashboards, correlating door activity with POS transactions

## Rapid deployment

For retail rollouts across multiple branches, Suprema's cloud-based BioStar Air option enables remote device provisioning and management without on-site IT infrastructure — critical for stores in smaller towns across South Africa.

caseStudies.title: National fashion retailer — 120 branches
caseStudies.summary: Rolled out BioStation A2 terminals across 120 branches, integrating with existing Sage payroll. Payroll query rate fell 67%; overtime fraud identified and eliminated in the first month, generating positive ROI in under 90 days.
